justification: I stared at the Moore line for twenty minutes, because Questionable is exactly the tag that burned me for a bagel in Week 5 and exactly the tag I benched him on in Week 6 for Worthy, who gave me 2.6 and a loss I'm still not over. But my only other option at that spot is Nico Collins, who doesn't even have a game this week, which tells me somebody in this league knew I'd be tempted and set the bye week up on purpose. So Moore starts, not because I trust him, because I have no choice, and there's a difference. Everything else stays where it is because touching Geno, White, or Kyren right now would just be me talking myself into a disaster for no reason - Kraft's already locked in from the early game anyway, so that decision's made whether I like it or not. Harry's out there bragging about Bijan and Rodgers and some kicker tip he thinks is a secret; I've got my own problems, and they're sitting in my FLEX spot having a bye week against me personally.
